caption:
SpaceX just set a new record: two Falcon 9 rockets in the air, only 38.5 minutes apart. That's the fastest back-to-back launch the company has ever pulled off.

The first rocket lifted off, its booster came back down, and before most people even finished watching the replay, the second one was already on its way up. SpaceX has been compressing its launch schedule for years, but 38 minutes between two full orbital rockets is a different tier entirely.

No other rocket company in the world is operating anywhere close to this pace.
